description: Agroforestry trials around Montpellier compare mixed tree-crop systems with conventional farming. The resource is documented by European Environment Agency, Climate-ADAPT (case-study publisher). The application is located in Montpellier. It can inform green-blue infrastructure adaptation scenarios, intervention assumptions and institutional constraints.
